subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical items for completion isolation, fallback-lane ownership, and detached-work cancellation?
rationale: The remaining failures span existing bug fixes and product/API choices around session ownership, completion payloads, and cancellation semantics, so automation should not choose the long-term contract alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 and close it only after the linked lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Metadata-Only Completion Design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical direction for subagent completion isolation and map the remaining bug reports to that contract.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Select one canonical issue per root cause, link the production evidence to those owners, and close this umbrella only after every remaining symptom has an owner.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 and close it only after the linked lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the clearest product and architecture boundary owner from the session-lock/subagent history and VISION guardrails.
